## Tour Highlights

After Iguazu, the journey continues into the Amazon. Rivers, flooded forest, canoes, piranhas, caimans and small communities replace the city views. Optional experiences include the famous Meeting of the Waters and an encounter with pink river dolphins. The trip ends with beach time in Búzios.

## Optional Excursions

In Rio: Roxy Show with dinner and private transfers (USD 260 per person), Cook in Rio (USD 250 per person), Pedra Bonita hike (USD 202 per person), bike tour (USD 250 per person) and a private 30-minute helicopter flight with transfer and guide (USD 641 per person).

In Iguazu: Macuco Safari (USD 130 per person), Bird Park (USD 50 per person) and a private 35-minute helicopter flight over the falls and national park (USD 3,666 per helicopter for 1–5 people). In the Amazon: Meeting of the Waters (USD 150 per person) and pink river dolphins (USD 100 per person).
